topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by connecting previous histopathology practicals to the day's learning outcomes on cellular transformation, oncogenes, and genetic instability.

topics.label: Tumor Virology, Cellular Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming viruses revealed that cancer originates from cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the definitions, genetic dominance, and cell cycle regulatory actions of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Sequence and Chromosomal Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the specific failures in DNA repair pathways and mitotic chromosome segregation that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-Step Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the stepwise accumulation of mutations and inherited genetic defects accelerate tumor progression and evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by offering recommended reading, inviting questions, and previewing the next topic.
